title: Illusionary Maze
next_chapter_hook: However, just as he was about to step out of the illusion, the surrounding scenery collapsed and reorganized like a shattered mirror—a far more ancient and terrifying aura awakened from the depths of the formation.

text.content: The resonance of the Tianji Record surged like a tide. Chen Ji felt his vision darken as an invisible force suddenly drained the spiritual energy from his entire body. The solid ground beneath his feet turned to nothingness, and he seemed to fall into a chaotic abyss. The wind howled past his ears, yet carried an eerie silence, as if the entire world had been separated by a thin membrane.

When he opened his eyes again, what greeted him was a familiar scene—the bamboo forest of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, morning mist swirling, dewdrops hanging from bamboo leaf tips, sparkling like crystals under the rising sun. Deep within the forest, a hunched figure stood with its back to him, clutching a yellowed ancient scroll in its hands.

dialogue.content: "You came." The voice was old yet gentle, carrying a sense of vicissitude Chen Ji knew all too well. "Your master has been waiting for you for a long time."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart suddenly tightened. That figure, that voice—unmistakably his master Mo Xiansheng, who had fallen three years ago. Yet he knew this was merely a fabricated illusion woven by the illusionary realm. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace radiated a faint warmth, as if silently reminding him of something.

The illusory Mo Xiansheng slowly turned around, his face bearing a kind smile, though his eyes held an inexplicable depth. "Ji'er, do you know why this master passed the Tianji Record to you?" His voice rang like a bell through the bamboo forest, each word striking Chen Ji's heart.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to his master's remnant shadow's questioning?

choices.description: Directly point out this is an illusion, maintain a steadfast heart, give the illusion no opportunity to exploit
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a clear and steadfast heart
choices.risk_hint: The illusion may escalate once exposed

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, his gaze calm as still water. "If you truly were my master, you wouldn't meet me in such a manner." His voice was not loud, yet every word was clear. "The bamboo forest behind the Tianqing Sect was destroyed by a mountain fire ten years ago—this illusion is quite careless."

The illusory Mo Xiansheng's form paused slightly, a flash of approval—or perhaps calculation—glittering in his eyes. "Worthy of being the successor I chose." He laughed. "But what if this master told you that none of this is an illusion?"

choices.description: Pretend to be fooled by the illusion, secretly observe weaknesses, seek the key to breaking the formation
choices.risk_hint: Those with unsteadfast hearts may be completely eroded by the illusion

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, a perfectly measured grief appearing on his face. He stumbled forward, his voice slightly trembling: "Master... are you truly still here? All these years, your disciple..." As he spoke, he stealthily drew his right hand behind his back, fingers rapidly forming seals, attempting to sense the spiritual energy flow of the formation.

The "Illusory Mo Xiansheng" seemed moved by his "genuine emotion," reaching out to stroke the top of his head. The moment those withered fingers were about to touch his hair, Chen Ji sensed an extremely faint spiritual energy fluctuation—from an old bamboo root three zhang to his front left.

choices.text: Break force with force, direct confrontation
choices.description: No废话, directly activate the Tianji Record's power to bombard the illusion's core
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious, this move may cost more than it gains

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a fierce killing intent flickering in his eyes. "Whether you are real or fake—" He formed seals with one hand, the Tianji Record Fragment blazing with golden light in his embrace. "—break apart for me!"

Golden light surged forth like a tide, and the entire illusion quivered violently. Yet in the next instant, countless figures suddenly materialized in the bamboo forest—all people from Chen Ji's memories: senior brothers who bullied him as a child, fellow disciples who robbed him of resources, even phantom images of his long-dead parents...

Countless fragments of memory flickered past Chen Ji's eyes like a carousel. Each scene carried a bone-deep emotional impact. He saw the scenes of being bullied by senior brothers in childhood, saw his parents' eyes死不瞑目 at their final moments, saw the mockery and coldness from the entire family when he was tested as having Five Elements mixed roots...

These memories should have been sealed in the deepest recesses of his heart long ago, yet now, catalyzed by the illusion, they surged forth, attempting to completely overwhelm him. Chen Ji felt a violent headache, as if something was tearing apart his Mental Sea. His breathing grew rapid, veins bulging on his forehead.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, haven't you always wanted to know the truth?" The phantom Mo Xiansheng's voice became evasive and uncertain, as if coming from beyond the nine heavens. "The Tianji Record chose you, never because of your talent... but because you were desperate enough, angry enough, easy enough... to be controlled."

text.content: These words were like a blade, piercing directly into Chen Ji's heart. He knew the illusion was trying to shake his道心, yet those words precisely struck the deepest fear within him. Was the Tianji Record truly exploiting him? Was Master Mo Xiansheng truly his savior, or another hand pushing him into the abyss?

choice.prompt: At the moment his heart was about to be lost, what choice should Chen Ji make?

choices.text: Awaken the Tianji Record's Heavenly Eye
choices.description: Actively burn Heavenly Fate, forcibly activate the Heavenly Eye ability to see through the illusion's essence
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Eye ability awakens, seeing through all illusions
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is a treasure for preserving life, consumed amounts cannot be restored

text.content: At the moment the illusion was about to completely devour him, Chen Ji suddenly bit through his tongue, spraying essence blood onto the Tianji Record Fragment. In an instant, the golden patterns on the fragment blazed madly, a scorching force spreading from his chest throughout his entire body—a vertical mark slowly cracked open at his Brow Center, revealing within it a profound and fathomless silver eye.
Heavenly Eye, open.

Where silver light passed, the illusion melted like snow and ice beneath the scorching sun. Those memories that once caused him unbearable pain turned to nothingness under the Heavenly Eye's illumination. His gaze penetrated the layers of illusions, locking onto the illusion's core—a suspended ancient formation plate floating in mid-air, emanating a faint blue glow.

choices.text: Hold fast to the original heart, break illusion with emotion
choices.description: Recall truly important people and things, use genuine bonds to combat false memories
choices.visible_reward: Mental state becomes complete, seeing through inner demons
choices.risk_hint: If bonds are not firm enough, one may be completely defeated by the illusion

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, no longer resisting the memories flooding in. He let those emotions of pain, anger, and despair wash over his heart, yet always preserved the final thread of clarity—because he thought of Chen Nian, his missing sister.

"I am on the path of searching for her," he silently recited in his heart. "Regardless of whether the Tianji Record brings fortune or calamity, regardless of whether Master is enemy or friend, I will never stop." At this very moment, a blurry image suddenly surfaced in his mind—a shattered formation plate, with a pattern Chen Nian loved most as a child carved in its center: a butterfly.

Cracks began appearing in the illusion. Those once indestructible memory scenes became fragmented, like a mirror struck by a heavy blow. The phantom Mo Xiansheng's form began to distort, the kind smile on his face gradually turning ferocious. "Do you think this is enough to escape?" His voice became sharp and shrill. "This formation was inherited from antiquity, having trapped and killed countless prodigies—you are merely another sacrifice!"

dialogue.content: At this moment, an old yet familiar voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind—the true Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice: "Child, there is a hidden pattern at the lower right corner of the formation plate. That is your only chance. Though the formation is powerful, it has a three-breath counterattack interval... Remember, three breaths."

text.content: Chen Ji's spirit lifted. Under the Heavenly Eye, the suspended formation plate appeared in perfect detail. He saw it—on the lower right corner of the formation plate, there truly was a nearly invisible hidden pattern, slightly different from other runes, like a deliberately concealed crack. Three breaths of counterattack interval, enough time for him to do many things.

choice.prompt: Having found the formation's weakness, how will Chen Ji break the formation?

choices.description: Gather all strength to attack the formation plate's hidden pattern, one strike to break the formation
choices.visible_reward: Instantly break the formation, escape successfully
choices.risk_hint: If the strike misses, will endure the formation's full counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, gathering all his spiritual energy at his fingertips. The Heavenly Eye locked onto the hidden pattern, the Tianji Record's power surging within his body. He transformed into a streak of light, rushing toward the formation plate with thunderous momentum—"Break!"

With a thunderous roar, the formation plate exploded. Countless specks of light scattered like meteors, and the entire illusion shattered like bubbles. Chen Ji felt the world spinning. When he stabilized himself, he found himself standing in a dark stone chamber. Ancient runes covered the walls on all sides, emanating a faint blue glow.

choices.text: Cleverly borrow force, break formation with formation
choices.description: Use the residual energy of the illusion to counterattack the formation, break it with minimal cost
choices.risk_hint: Any deviation in timing leads to complete failure

text.content: A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He did not rashly attack, but slowly raised both hands, beginning to form seals—what he sought was not a head-on collision, but to borrow force and redirect it. Though the illusion had shattered, the emotional energy contained within those memory fragments had not dissipated. If he could guide this force toward the formation plate...

Three breaths later, the emotional energy pervading the space was entirely drawn by him, like an invisible blade accurately piercing into the formation plate's hidden pattern. The formation plate let out a mournful cry, cracks spreading across its surface, and it collapsed with a thunderous sound. Chen Ji calmly brushed the dust from his robes, without even taking a single step.

The stone chamber was deep and silent, only the faint blue glow from the ancient runes flowing slowly across the walls. Chen Ji warily scanned his surroundings, the afterglow of the Heavenly Eye not yet fully faded. He could faintly sense the formation energy lingering in this stone chamber—extremely ancient, far beyond his comprehension.

At this moment, a section of runes on the wall suddenly illuminated. A illusory figure slowly condensed from the light. It was a middle-aged man in white robes, his features handsome yet carrying an indescribable majesty. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, a flash of surprise flickering in his eyes.

dialogue.content: "To break this one's illusion with a Foundation Building cultivation..." The white-robed illusion's voice was ethereal and distant. "What's more interesting is that you carry the aura of the Tianji Record." His gaze deepened, as if examining something. "Interesting... most interesting."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. This illusion's aura far surpassed any powerful figure he had ever encountered. Even if it was merely a remnant strand of will, it was enough to make him feel suffocating pressure. And what this person mentioned—the "Tianji Record"—what connection did this ancient great being have with the Tianji Record?

The white-robed illusion seemed to see through his thoughts, smiling faintly. "No need to be nervous. This is merely a test of will this one left behind." He gestured, and a stone wall at the depths of the chamber rumbled open, revealing a dark passage beyond. "Since you could reach here, it means you are qualified to know some... secrets."

Chen Ji did not immediately step into the passage, but asked in a deep voice: "Who are you, senior? Why leave an inheritance here?" He knew that nothing falls from the sky. A test arranged by a powerhouse of this level must surely hide enormous opportunities or dangers behind it.

dialogue.content: The white-robed illusion seemed quite appreciative of his caution: "Well asked." He contemplated briefly. "This one's name has long been erased by time, but the world calls me—Formation Ancestor. As for why I left an inheritance here..." His gaze deepened. "Because I am waiting for a person who can change the world's pattern."

text.content: However, just as Chen Ji was about to step into the passage, violent tremors suddenly came from beneath his feet. Cracks began appearing on all the stone chamber walls, a berserk aura gushing from the depths of the earth. The white-robed illusion's expression changed for the first time: "Not good... It's awakening!" For the first time,gravetinted his voice. "The formation counterattack has come three hundred years earlier than expected—run!"

The ceiling of the stone chamber began to collapse, rocks falling like rain. Those originally gentle ancient runes now transformed into ferocious blood-red, emanating a nauseating stench of decay. Chen Ji felt cold sweat on his back, an unprecedented fear surging in his heart—a warning emitted from the deepest本能of life, as if some terrifying existence from antiquity was awakening.

However, just as he turned to leave, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly quivered violently. A strange pulling force came from the depths of the stone chamber, resonating with the Tianji Record. That feeling was both familiar and unfamiliar, as if calling to him—calling him toward the deeper depths.

Chen Ji fell into brief hesitation. Behind him was the collapsing stone chamber, a retreat of unknown fate; ahead lay unknown opportunities, and that mysterious force resonating with the Tianji Record. The white-robed illusion's warning still echoed in his ears, yet the pulling force grew ever stronger, like a voice whispering in his mind: Come... come here... The other half of the Tianji Record... lies just ahead...

However, at this crucial moment when Chen Ji was about to make his choice, a faint pattern suddenly appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment—that was the final mark left by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. The old voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Child... whatever you choose, remember—the Tianji Record's completeness, though it can bring you power, also means... the inevitable counterattack of fate will multiply by leaps and bounds."

The stone chamber's collapse grew ever more violent. The dark blue passage entrance flickered intermittently in the blood-red light. That force pulling the Tianji Record continued, even growing stronger as he approached. Chen Ji clenched his fists, a decisive gleam flashing in his eyes. He took a deep breath, and made his decision—
